## What I Build

I design and build backend systems, REST APIs, and server-side infrastructure for startups and product teams. I also build AI-integrated features, automation pipelines, and web scraping systems.

Core strengths:
- High-performance REST API design and implementation
- Concurrent web scraping and browser automation (headless Chrome via go-rod / CDP)
- Data pipeline and processing systems
- AI integration (Claude AI, Google Gemini)
- Real-time systems (Server-Sent Events, WebSockets)
- Scalable backend architecture and system design
- Database engineering (schema design, query optimisation, migrations)
- SaaS product backends with billing, multi-tenancy, and role-based access

## Technical Skills

**Languages:** Python, Golang, PHP
**Frameworks:** Django, GoFiber, Laravel
**Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite (via GORM)
**APIs & Protocols:** REST, WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE), HMAC partner APIs
**Automation & Scraping:** go-rod (Chrome DevTools Protocol), goquery, gjson, concurrent fan-out scraping with goroutines and semaphores
**AI/ML Integration:** Claude AI (Anthropic), Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash-lite)
**Payments:** Paystack (gateway, dedicated virtual accounts, webhooks)
**DevOps:** GitHub Actions CI, Air (Go live reload), Swagger/swaggo
**Other:** JWT auth, bcrypt, Telegram Bot API alerting, Cloudinary, SMTP mailers

## Notable Projects

### QuickAir (https://quickair.app)
B2B flight aggregation and booking platform for Nigerian travel agencies.
- Concurrent fan-out search across 12 Nigerian airline portals in real time
- Headless browser automation fleet (go-rod + CDP) with a global browser semaphore and per-airline Chrome profile pools
- Durable ticket issuance queue with atomic job claiming, dependent-segment ordering, and a 5-step persistent recovery poller
- Paystack DVA wallet, HMAC partner API, SSE streaming, Claude AI chat
- Stack: Golang, GoFiber, GORM, PostgreSQL, React 19 + TypeScript

### MyRoomStatus (https://myroomstatus.com)
Full-stack hotel property management system for the West African market.
- Dual deployment: cloud SaaS (PostgreSQL) and self-contained offline binary (SQLite + go:embed)
- Smart lock integration across five vendors behind a single Provider interface; DouWin RFID bridge agent via CGo + Windows DLL
- Real-time WebSocket dashboard hub and Smart TV notification hub
- Google Gemini AI support chatbot with hotel-specific knowledge base
- SaaS billing with Paystack, multi-property group reporting, granular RBAC
- Stack: Golang, GoFiber, GORM, PostgreSQL/SQLite, React 19 + TypeScript + Zustand
